facts.claim: Tool capability abstractions and permissions are declared in missy/tools/base.py.
ToolRegistry registers tools and is the execution gateway; it checks policy before calling tool.execute and emits audit events.
CalculatorTool exposes a typed safe-arithmetic tool and declares shell, filesystem and network permissions false.
Tool schemas are offered to function-calling integrations through BaseTool.get_schema, with tools allowed to override it.

required_distinctions: A schema exposed to a model is not authorization to execute the tool.
The repository evidence does not establish the deployment's enabled tool set or active provider configuration.
